## Projects

### Agent Circuit Breaker (ACB)

A published beta Python package (v1.7.2, released November 9, 2026) for deterministic runtime authorization. Install: `python -m pip install agent-circuit-breaker==1.7.2`.

A separate owner service holds resources, credentials, policy, and approval authority. Agents request typed file operations, owner-registered SQLite maintenance, and exact S3-compatible publication. Single-use approvals, cumulative file/row/export-byte budgets, and uncertain execution persist through restart. Supported transformations preserve labels; only the owner can declassify reviewed bytes. Signed evidence supports independent retention and verification.

The owner route requires Python 3.11+ on Linux/macOS. Protected deployment requires OS isolation, distinct UIDs, protected owner state/control sockets, and removal of alternate resource access. Same-UID development is a rehearsal. SQLite support is bounded; export-byte budgets count S3 payloads, not all information flow. HMAC evidence is not immutable.

Existing typed Workflow and workflow-mcp tools remain supported. The owner MCP client adds separated authority. Native hooks rely on their host, and the legacy proxy does not own RuntimeGate's execution lifecycle. Host configuration/SDK paths are tested; native desktop hosts and live AWS are not certified. Outcomes ALLOW, BLOCK, UNKNOWN, ERROR, and PENDING_APPROVAL remain distinct; only ALLOW authorizes execution.

Published v1.7.2 evidence records 723 regression tests plus 444 subtests, 133 legacy live checks, 37 MinIO observed-effect checks, and 8 separate-UID Linux isolation checks. These are finite synthetic acceptance results, not certification. Website policy and approval examples were freshly recorded from v1.7.2 on November 11; the existing video is explicitly a historical v1.7.0 recording. Browser interactions do not execute commands.

- [Project and owner workflow](https://sagarchhatrala.github.io/agent-circuit-breaker/#owner)
- [Structured capabilities and limits](https://sagarchhatrala.github.io/agent-circuit-breaker/project.json)
- [Release and execution evidence](https://github.com/sagarchhatrala/agent-circuit-breaker/releases/tag/v1.7.2)
- [Owner guide](https://github.com/sagarchhatrala/agent-circuit-breaker/blob/v1.7.2/docs/OWNER_SERVICE.md)
- [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/agent-circuit-breaker/1.7.2/)
- [FAUN.toolbox listing and scorecard](https://faun.dev/toolbox/agent-circuit-breaker/)

### Horizon Agent Containment (HAC)

A research prototype for deterministic containment of long-horizon agents. It tracks state, provenance, authority, and graph relationships, then evaluates whether a transition creates a capability forbidden by configured security invariants. For example, transformed secret-derived data retains its lineage and an external upload is blocked.

HAC operates on explicitly modeled state and invariants. The consolidated HAC project page hosts recorded scenario replays. The executable Python engine and Streamlit demo are in the repository. ACB handles actions and trajectories; HAC investigates capabilities arising from accumulated state. The projects are independent and can be complementary.

- [Source, architecture, and executable demo](https://github.com/sagarchhatrala/horizon-agent-containment)
- [Project and recorded scenarios](https://sagarchhatrala.github.io/horizon-agent-containment/)
- [Structured HAC project facts](https://sagarchhatrala.github.io/horizon-agent-containment/project.json)

### KECHAA (Kernel-Enforced Containment for Hijacked AI Agents)

Open-source research prototype for authorization-bound agent tool execution. Sagar contributes as a developer and researcher. Commands are bound to task contracts and single-use signed grants, with approval workflows, replay protection, and signed audit records. Its experimental Linux backend uses Landlock, seccomp, namespaces, and cgroups to restrict command and descendant effects. See the project README for current verification gaps.

- [Source and architecture](https://github.com/ruchithamohan/KECHAA-Kernel-Enforced-Containment-for-Hijacked-AI-Agents)
